description: This file contains an extension to OnboardingView, defining various user interaction methods such as selecting gateways, opening settings, navigation controls, finishing onboarding, and copying text to the clipboard.

methods.name: selectLocalGateway
methods.description: Sets the connection mode to local, resets preferred gateway ID, disables advanced connection, and updates preferences accordingly.

methods.name: selectUnconfiguredGateway
methods.description: Cancels current onboarding task, sets connection mode to unconfigured, resets preferred gateway ID, disables advanced connection, and updates preferences.

methods.name: selectRemoteGateway
methods.description: Cancels current onboarding task, sets preferred gateway ID, updates preferences, applies remote selection, and sets connection mode to remote.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Requests to open a specific settings tab and posts a notification to update the UI accordingly.

methods.name: handleBack
methods.description: Navigates back to the previous onboarding page with animation.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Navigates to the next onboarding page or finishes onboarding if on the last page.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks onboarding as seen in user defaults and closes the onboarding view.

methods.name: copyToPasteboard
methods.description: Copies provided text to the system pasteboard, gives visual feedback for copying, and resets after 1.2 seconds.
